title: Demographic Projections
description: CBO projections of population, fertility, mortality, and migration by age, sex, and other dimensions.
format_note: Demographic data is stored in tidy (multi-column) format rather than the 3-column long format used for economic data, since demographics have multi-dimensional keys (age, sex, etc.).

population_bls.description: Civilian noninstitutional population by age and sex (BLS basis)

population_census.description: Civilian noninstitutional population by age and sex (Census basis)

fertility.description: Fertility rates by age and place of birth

mortality.description: Mortality rates by age and sex

migration.description: Migration flows by age, sex, immigration status, and direction

ss_area_population.description: Social Security area population by age, sex, and marital status
